title: Vermont Statutes Annotated, Title 32, Chapter 151 - Income Taxes
deposited: 32 V.S.A. ch. 151, whole chapter (Income Taxes): taxable income from federal AGI with Vermont modifications (5811(21)), adoption of the federal income tax laws as in effect on December 31, 2025 (5824), the rate tables (5822), the earned income tax credit at 38% / 100% of the federal credit (5828b), the child and dependent care credit (5828c), the Social Security and retirement income exclusion (5830e), the Vermont child tax credit (5830f), withholding (subch. 4) and returns.
